environment.runtime: x64 console in a Hyper-V-isolated Windows Server Core LTSC 2022 container
environment.candidate: GNU-target x64 build in the same environment
environment.input: Win32 console key events with scan codes and modifier state
environment.fixtures: Generated raw instruction streams and a generated PE32+ image. No inspected file was executed.

layout.pe32_plus: The 17-character split address shifts opcode, target label, mnemonic, and ordinary operand columns nine cells right.
layout.selected_byte: The two opcode digits use dark blue on gray in view mode.

observations.automatic_raw_profile: The ordinary raw fixtures opened Decode in automatic x86-32.
observations.short_padding: Two adjacent 0x90 bytes appeared as a single NOP row. On the 80x25 raw fixture, Page Down moved to 0x1A. Page Up returned the viewport to 0 and selected 0x19.
observations.operand_examples: Register, immediate, memory, and branch operand colors matched on the generated 16-, 32-, and 64-bit sequences. The reference uses a prefixed hexadecimal literal, bracketed displacement terms, and a return separator.
observations.file_bytes: The SHA-256 values of the three exercised fixtures matched their generated originals after both programs closed.

paired_checks.coverage: Raw viewing, per-byte selection, forward and backward page movement, entry into byte edit, x86 profile changes, and the initial PE32+ viewport.
paired_checks.comparison: The body comparison includes all instruction rows and the scrollbar, normalizes terminal default black, and ignores foreground on spaces.
paired_checks.limits: Five matching bodies had a different held-Ctrl function bar. Inline Goto to the PE entry placed the target at row 15 in HIEW and row 1 in the candidate. The exact branch annotations, syntax and decoder behavior of untested instruction families remain open.
